insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual/Family Floater: 5L to 3Cr (by plan). Family First: Base Individual SI 1L to 15L + Floater SI as per formula (by plan).

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: Provides a refill of up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured once the available cover is used. This increases protection for multiple hospitalizations in the same policy year.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
great.reference: Section 5.1.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period- Code- Excl02
great.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are not covered for the first 12 months from the first policy start date. This is shorter than the common 24-month waiting period, so coverage starts sooner.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 90 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 90 days before hospitalization if related to the same admission. This reduces out-of-pocket costs for tests and consultations leading up to admission.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage from the first policy inception. This is a standard waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 180 days after discharge if related to the same hospitalization. This helps pay for follow-up medicines, tests, and consultations.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered in the first 30 days from the first policy start date, but accidents are covered immediately. This is a common market-standard waiting period.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room rent Covered up to Sum Insured (except for Suite or above room category)
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Individual & Family Floater variant)
good.explanation: Room rent is covered up to the Sum Insured, but Suite (or above) category rooms are not covered. This generally avoids a daily room-rent cap, but choosing a suite can lead to non-payable expenses.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization... The Domiciliary Hospitalization continues for at least 3 consecutive days
good.explanation: Home treatment (domiciliary hospitalization) is covered on a reimbursement basis if it continues for at least 3 consecutive days. This can help when hospital admission is not possible or medically advised at home.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: Modern Treatments Covered up to Sum Insured with sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.25 (robotic special condition)
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered up to the Sum Insured, but some robotic surgeries are capped at ₹1 lakh. This can create higher out-of-pocket costs if a robotic procedure is recommended.

good.name: NCB
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions... by increasing the Sum Insured... by 10% of the Base Sum Insured... subject to a maximum of 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Adds 10% of the Base Sum Insured on renewal as a loyalty addition, up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured. This increases your available cover over time if you keep renewing.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure VII - The expenses that are not covered... List  I – Expenses not covered... 56 GLOVES... 60 MASK... 57 NEBULISATION KIT... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure VII - The expenses that are not covered or subsumed...
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves, masks, nebulisation kits, and various procedure kits are not covered. This can materially increase your hospital bill out of pocket even when the main treatment is covered.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: This benefit is covered up to a limit of Rs. 50,000.
bad.explanation: HIV/AIDS treatment is capped at ₹50,000. Any admissible expenses beyond this limit would be paid by you, reducing protection for this condition.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: If You select Zone 2, then 20% Co-payment will apply for treatment in Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai & Thane), Delhi NCR, Kolkata & Gujarat State.
bad.explanation: If Zone 2 is selected, a 20% co-pay applies for treatment in Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai & Thane), Delhi NCR, Kolkata, and Gujarat State. This means you must bear 20% of the admissible claim amount in these locations.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
